query: BEGIN TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY; SET LOCAL statement_timeout='8s'; SET LOCAL lock_timeout='3s'; SELECT clock_timestamp() observed_at,p.oid::text oid,p.oid::regprocedure::text signature,pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) definition,encode(sha256(convert_to(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'UTF8')),'hex') source_sha256,encode(sha256(convert_to((to_jsonb(p)-'prosrc')::text,'UTF8')),'hex') metadata_sha256 FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.oid IN(to_regprocedure('astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_snapshot_task_v2(text)'),to_regprocedure('astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_plan_snapshot_v2(text,integer)'),to_regprocedure('astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_seal_plan_v2(text,bigint,text,jsonb)')) ORDER BY p.oid; COMMIT;
